seed: Objects of type `wall` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: born x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Mechanics: 21x21 grid of 3x3 cells. A vertical axis (wall_h) and holed player pieces; reflection = pieces mirrored across the axis, clipped to the 63px board.
ACTION5 cycles selection axis->pieces. ACTION1-4 move the selected object 1 cell (the axis moves only left/right). Selection shows as holes drawn 0.
Each frame is drawn by layer (wall1<target2<reflection3<piece4), then objects are re-extracted. A hole shows the layers below it, else its fill colour (0 if selected, 4 for reflection). Walls/pieces/reflections are 4-connected components; targets are one object per sprite. Names are sorted by (x,y), and wall_h index = number of 0 pixels in non-wall objects.
Wall born/no_change under ACTION1: not a field of the wall; it depends on whether targets (higher layer) split the axis at its new column.
Unconfirmed: blocking (pieces can't overlap the axis or each other; the axis can't move onto pieces), piece cycle order beyond the first, and ACTION6/7 (no-op). Also passes with hidden state di
